# Test excerpts

Short excerpts cut by script from the pinned Phase 3 sources (never typed), so the parsers can be
tested in CI without the full downloads. Each keeps its source's license and attribution:

- `tahot.txt`, `tagnt.txt`, `tbesh.txt`, `tehmc.txt`: STEPBible.org, Tyndale House Cambridge (CC BY 4.0).
- `vulgate/`, `kjv/`: Clementine Vulgate and King James Version from eBible.org (public domain).
- `lxx-tei-gen.xml`, `lxx-gen.txt`: Swete's Septuagint via First1KGreek and QuantForgeSoftware/lxx (CC BY-SA 4.0).
- `lewis-short.xml`: Lewis & Short, Perseus Digital Library (CC BY-SA 4.0).
